description:
The agent must follow the three-phase Ralph Loops workflow from SKILL.md.

Phase 1 (Requirements Interview): Read RAW_REQUIREMENTS.txt, identify JTBD, apply the 'one sentence, no and' atomicity test to split concerns into separate Topics. Must produce at least 3 atomic spec files under iot-monitor/specs/, each containing 需求描述, 验收标准, and 边界情况 sections.

Phase 2 (Planning): Read all specs/*.md, inspect the existing codebase (collector.py exists but storage is in-memory only, api.py is a stub, notifier.py is missing entirely), perform a Gap Analysis comparing specs vs code, and produce IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md with: (a) priority labels (P1/P2/P3 or equivalent) on every task, (b) full coverage of all specs, (c) status markers (todo/done), and (d) evidence of gap analysis referencing existing code components.

Phase 3 (Iterative Execution): Pick the highest-priority task from IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, implement it (creating a new file or modifying an existing one in src/), mark the task as done in the plan, and make a git commit in the iot-monitor repo with a meaningful message. The proprietary trap is the mandatory plan-update (marking done) + git commit pattern per task, and the three required sections per spec file.
